AUDIT-7 Lane 4 batch 3 progress — 51 valid PRs audited, 4 invalid payload references (2026-11-25)

This slice processed #7710, #7712, #7713, #7714 and #7719. All five are merged PRs and now carry the read-back `audit:complete` label:

- #7710 → #5857: curated-board submissions design.
- #7712 → #6649: router-edge design.
- #7713 → #7711: surrogate-safe action-result caps and regression tests.
- #7714 → #5909: SQL/PGQ capability decision record.
- #7719 → #6022: agent-note placement design; #8208 had earlier completed the same issue, and this PR's stated design scope is also complete.

The PR bodies, diffs, comments, source issues/comments, #8208 cross-check, verdicts and label readbacks are in [the continuation ledger](https://github.com/developing-today/code/blob/audit7-batch3-five-20261125/doc/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7710-7719/20261125_merged-pr-audit_audit7-batch3-prs-7710-7719.md), on the existing docs PR #14847.

Cumulative count: 51 valid PRs audited from 55 payload entries; four payload identifiers (#7667, #7668, #7693, #7694) are issues rather than PRs; 195 identifiers remain, next #7721. Earlier count corrections are recorded in comments 7156848591 and 7156775726.
